impact: Losing part of Nvidia's backing dents the AI-networking story behind NOK's rally and can weigh on the stock near term, though Nvidia still holds a sizeable position and the 13F reflects Q3 trades, not new selling.
summary: Nokia shares fell more than 4% Tuesday after Nvidia's quarterly 13F filing showed it cut its Nokia stake by 56% in Q3, to 72.86 million shares worth $738.8M at Sept. 30 from 166.39 million at the end of June. The same filing showed Nvidia trimming its Intel stake. Separately, Nokia announced a partnership with Nscale, Skeleton, Telia and Verda to set up an AI Gigafactory Northern.
title: Nvidia cuts Nokia stake by 56%; Nokia falls more than 4%
